sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
'Brain IQ test' is a multiplayer puzzle game that challenges players to answer a series of questions in a timed environment. The game is divided into levels, each with a set of questions and a timer that decreases as you answer. If you answer a question correctly, you'll earn points, but if you fail, your opponents will have the chance to steal the points. The game also features a unique mechanic called HAKI, which can be used to aid you in tough situations. There are two types of HAKI: Save and Froze. Save will give you an extra chance to answer a question, while Froze will freeze the timer for a set amount of time, allowing you to take your time and think more carefully. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new characters and HAKI, which can be used to gain an edge over your opponents.

One of the key features of 'Brain IQ test' is its randomly generated opponents. Each level, you'll face off against a new set of players, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. This means that you'll need to adapt your strategy to each new opponent and think on your feet to succeed. The game also features multiple game modes, including a ranked mode where you can compete against other players in a tournament-style setting.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of 'Brain IQ test' are engaging and challenging, making for a fun and addictive experience. Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore gamer, there's something for everyone in this game.
